Stage: M9 (05b-stages-migration.md). Plan run dir on epic ancora-yzu. Common migration checklist items 1-12 from 05b apply (see M6 for the expanded list).

Deliverable:
Atlas PR: dep stays all-envs/runtime (Atlas consumes the parser at runtime); remove the elixirc_options tracer from mix.exs; delete realization_hashes.json (142 KB) and the untracked local state.json; strip 111 realized_by: / 1001 execute:; make/worktree.mk:402-406 spec-check/spec-check-full collapse to one spec-check: mix spec.check; Makefile spec-validate retargets; docker-compose.yml:52 remove SPECLED_COMMAND_OUTPUT_DIR and SPECLED_SHOW_INFO arming; CLAUDE.md lines 40/44-46, .claude/dynamic-rules/worktree-mix-targets.md and the 3 other worktree rules mentioning spec-check; AGENTS.md host/container split collapses to one loop. Topology decision recorded in the PR (04a M7): where the agent loop runs the gate post-migration; if in-container, one in-topology sanity run measures the compose-exec overhead. Atlas.Parser.SpecDoc retargets to Ancora.Parser.parse_file/2 AND Ancora.DecisionParser.parse_file/2 (two public modules), both named in ancora README stable-API section; verify the text matches reality. Perf acceptance (binding): bench/gate_bench.exs against the pinned Atlas commit on Manuel machine, median-of-3, warm _build, must land < 10 s (spec.check) and < 5 s (prime/next/status/validate). A miss blocks this PR and triggers the recorded on-disk-cache re-entry decision, not ad-hoc tuning. If this PR bounces, split the SpecDoc retarget + tracer removal from the corpus strip.

Verification:
- Tests to pass: Atlas CI green end to end including the shim new path; Atlas test suite green with SpecDoc retargeted
- Behaviors to demonstrate: mix spec.check green on the PR head; format/retired_construct = 0; config/unknown_key = 0; bench medians recorded on the ticket and under budget; topology decision recorded; migration ADR with counts and override reasons; .claude/rules/specled.md absent; retired-vocabulary grep zero
- Verification cadence:
  - Iteration tier: mix spec.check --base origin/main and mix spec.status in Atlas; bench once
  - Final tier: Atlas CI green; bench median-of-3 under budget
  - Verifier tier: checklist 1-12 against the diff plus the recorded bench numbers; no suite runs
- Standing bounce-class checks: every checklist item ticked with evidence; SpecDoc production call path has a passing Atlas test
- Call-site Integration: Atlas.Parser.SpecDoc is the production caller of the two stable parse_file/2 functions; proving tests are the existing Atlas SpecDoc tests passing on the PR.

Out of Scope (files):
- /Users/mz/src/ancora/** (except a README text fix if the stable-API section is wrong, via its own ticket)
- any other consumer repo
Allowed touches (this stage may modify):
- Atlas: mix.exs, mix.lock, .spec/**, .claude/**, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, Makefile, make/worktree.mk, docker-compose.yml, lib/atlas/parser/spec_doc.ex and its tests, CI config if it names retired flags

Out of Scope (intent):
- no vendoring of the parser; the retarget is the stability commitment
- never config-off a code without an ADR line; never edit spec text to dodge a finding
- a perf miss is the on-disk-cache re-entry decision, not tuning in this PR

Merge gate:
- [ ] Atlas CI green including the shim new path
- [ ] Bench medians under budget, recorded on the ticket
- [ ] Checklist items 1-12 checked in the PR description
- [ ] Migration ADR merged with the PR
- [ ] Auditor APPROVE comment on the ticket
